answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a sparrow checkpoint. The whisper chain is verified at intake and delta publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 22 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
